Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 90. Category: form. Red Eye.

Power-Up
Your Eye has reached its full potential and is even
better than before.
Increase your Power by 3
You gain a +2 to all Wisdom (Perception) checks
The range of all Standard Ki Attacks and Ki
Techniques increase by 50% (1/2)
Your Critical Threat Range increases by 1
At the end of your turn, you lose 3 Stamina
At level 10 this Power-Up replaces “Red Eye
Activation”
